scope.settingsMethod: Preferences selected through actual settings controls and color inputs; no stored preferences or source CSS injected.
assertions: Accent headings, links, service marks and icon colors >=4.5
All four Apps tabs visible without horizontal swipe at 130% text
Website/public app settings opens with Close focused
Gate Home is physically right and Settings physically left with no overlap
Gate Home label translates to English
Gate bottom content fits or remains scroll-reachable
Installed login/demo/settings render with readable accent colors

methodology.contrast: Computed foreground and background colors sampled in running browsers; translucent backgrounds composited over ancestor backgrounds, ratios calculated from sRGB relative luminance. Representative screenshots reviewed visually.
methodology.fixtures: Local release availability and empty announcement responses stabilize UI layout. No customer/provider credentials supplied. Local preview APIs are not a production backend test.
methodology.emulation: Browser viewport, user-agent, desktop bridge flag and standalone flag simulation. No physical iPhone, Windows installation or TV device test claimed.
methodology.boundaries: This report verifies local UI. It does not claim deployment, live provider playback, real system notification delivery or native release publication.
